_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Simulator controls now fit narrow panels on Default and Valinor. Trial status is beside the trial number, keeping successful and aborted outcomes visible while settings scroll. Existing Bench tools remain available in their own scrolling section.

Validated with 42 focused tests per branch, narrow/wide panel bounds, full layout audit, and GUI smoke checks with no exceptions. Firmware, control, calibration, acquisition, and safety settings remain unchanged. Includes the preceding release's complete NI failed-read journals.
